messages:
Leah: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we had three vendor-related failure modes (cloud region flake, model-registry 503s, and OAuth token refresh errors). We need concrete owners and dates for mitigations.
Alex: I can take the cloud-region failover items. TL;DR: improve multi-region routing + runbook steps to switch to us-west2 if us-east1 has >3min degradation.
Sam: For the model-registry 503s, we saw retries pile up and starve inference workers. Proposal: add circuit-breaker at the registry client + cached model metadata fallback. I can prototype this week.
Maria: OAuth token refresh failures are hitting long-lived background jobs. We should add better metrics (refresh_fail_count) and increase refresh grace window. I'll own this.
Leah: Thanks — can each owner add a single-line JIRA ticket and ETA in this thread? We want to track in the postmortem follow-up doc and include in the recurring-incident checklist.
Alex: JIRA: INF-4821 "Region failover policy + runbook" ETA: 2024-12-05. Steps: add healthcheck gating on routing, automate failover via traffic-manager, and update incident runbook.
Sam: JIRA: INF-4822 "Model-registry circuit-breaker and local metadata cache" ETA: 2024-11-28. Implementation: breaker with backoff, local TTL cache for model manifests (fallback mode). I'll add unit+e2e tests.
Maria: JIRA: INF-4823 "OAuth refresh observability and grace window" ETA: 2024-11-30. Plan: new metrics+alert, bump grace to 5m for background jobs, doc runbook for manual token refresh.
James: Ops note — we should also schedule a quarterly dependency review to catch repeated vendor flakiness. Suggest quarterly meeting owned by platform (James) to review SLAs and create mitigation roadmaps. I'll own scheduling.
Leah: Good call. James, add a recurring calendar (Q1 cadence) and add a short template to capture: vendor, symptom, frequency, mitigations in place, and next steps.
ops-bot: Incident created: P-2108 linked to this thread (automated).
Alex: Quick question — for the registry cache, what's acceptable staleness? We should set TTL per-model (default 15m) and an emergency "last-known-good" binary if registry returns 5xx.
Sam: That sounds right. We should also expose a /healthz that includes registry dependency status so routing can be smarter.
Maria: For OAuth, I'll add an alert that fires at 3% refresh_fail_rate over 5m. If it trips, runbook -> rotate token + notify infra oncall.
Leah: OK owners and ETAs noted. Action items summary: Alex (region failover) ETA 2024-12-05; Sam (registry circuit-breaker + cache) ETA 2024-11-28; Maria (OAuth observability + grace) ETA 2024-11-30; James (quarterly vendor review scheduling) ETA 2024-12-02.
Leah: Also, please add a short note in the postmortem doc about recurrence indications (we observed minor registry blips 3x in last 30 days) so product & platform can prioritize.
Alex: Will add a short regression test in CI that simulates 503s from registry and ensures fallback path is exercised.
Sam: I'll include a small benchmark to ensure the cache doesn't bloat memory under high model counts.
Maria: I'll draft the alert runbook and link to OAuth provider support contact.
Leah: Thanks team — let's reconvene in the incident channel next Friday for status. :thumbsup:
